take: Washington announced it placed center Pierre-Luc Dubois on injured reserve and recalled right wing Jonny Brodzinski from Hershey (AHL). Dubois had four points in four games and controlled 60 percent of the 5-on-5 chance quality while on the ice. Dylan Strome has already taken his spot beside Tuch and Wilson, now at 18:43 a night from 14:46, and Ryan Leonard has moved onto the first power-play unit. Brodzinski played 8:34 in his one game this season, and the Capitals were outplayed in his minutes.
